segments.text: (Rabba...
oh Rabba...)
Tang galiyon ki is bheed mein Pao mere thak se gaye the Puranay
sheeshe ki aik dukan par Kadam achanak ruk se gaye the Kaanch
ke tukde par chamki nazar Aks tumhara wahan dikha Mudh ke
dekha na tha abhi tak Par dil mera wahi bik gaya Ruk gayi hawa,
thak gaya samaa Ek hi pal mein badla jahan Sunno na...
Aaine mein dekha pehli baar tumhein Ho gaya pehli
nazar mein pyar tumhein Dhanak se rang sab khil gaye Jab
se hum is mod par mil gaye (Ho gaya pyar tumhein...
ho gaya pyar...)
Kaan ki baali jab hili
tumhari Dhadkan meri bhi tezz hui Bazaar ki rounak phiki
lagi Sirf tumhari aahat azeez hui Mudh ke dekha toh tum thi
samne Jhulfein hawa mein lehra rahi thi Har baat jo main
kehna chahta tha Tumhari ankhein bata rahi thi Ruk gayi hawa,
thak gaya samaa Ek hi pal mein badla jahan Sunno na...
Aaine mein dekha pehli baar tumhein Ho gaya pehli nazar mein
pyar tumhein Dhanak se rang sab khil gaye Jab se hum is mod par
mil gaye Ab na koi rasta yaad rahe Bus tera hi rasta yaad rahe
Sitar ki taar jaisi bajti hai Meri saanson mein ab teri sada
(Meri saanson mein teri sada...) Aaine mein dekha pehli baar
tumhein Ho gaya pehli nazar mein pyar tumhein Dhanak se rang sab
khil gaye Jab se hum is mod par mil gaye Pehli nazar mein...
(Pehli nazar mein...) Pehli nazar mein pyar tumhein...
Pehli nazar mein...
